About this product

The Ubiquiti UACC-DAC-SFP10-1M is a passive SFP+ Direct Attach Cable (DAC) designed for high-speed network links. This 1-metre cable provides a reliable 10 Gbps connection between devices equipped with SFP+ ports, such as UniFi switches. It serves as a cost-effective and low-latency solution for short-distance interconnections within a rack or between adjacent racks, eliminating the need for separate SFP+ transceivers and fibre cables.
